_comment: Bundled example connections — the modern shape of the old per-environment named adapter instances. A connection IS an adapter instance; environments are pure selectors. None is marked `default` (that is a per-deployment choice; run POST /admin/migrate/seed-default-connections or set it in the editor).

hsm_primary.description: Primary HSM (header-echo host command). Was multi-instance/hsm_primary.

hsm_backup.description: Backup HSM — inherits hsm_primary, different host. Was multi-instance/hsm_backup.

payments_grpc.description: gRPC payments service via a compiled descriptor set. Was grpc/payments_grpc.

discovered_grpc.description: gRPC service discovered via server reflection. Was grpc/discovered_grpc.

inline_proto_grpc.proto_inline: syntax = "proto3"; package demo; service Echo { rpc Say (Msg) returns (Msg); } message Msg { string text = 1; }
inline_proto_grpc.description: gRPC service from inline .proto source. Was grpc/inline_proto_grpc.

http_live.description: Live HTTP/REST endpoint, parameterised from global variables (http_*). Was http-live/http.

payshield_hsm.description: payShield 10K simulator on the classic host port. Was payshield-sim/hsm.

prod_http.description: Production HTTP/REST payment server (template). Was production-template/http.

prod_db_probe.description: Production core DB read-only probe (template). Was production-template/db_probe_core.
